limits: For red wine, Mourvèdre and Syrah together: at least 20%
For red wine, Cinsault: at most 25%
For red wine, Carignan and Cinsault together: at most 10%
For white wine, Carignan, Chenin Blanc, Grenache Blanc, Rolle and Roussanne together: at least 70%
For white wine, Viognier: at most 10%
For white wine, Assyrtiko: at most 5%
